grid.columns: column 0 = -180 deg, east-positive; row 0 = +90 deg; pixel-registered
grid.heights: metres above MOLA's areoid (GMM3 mgm1025 to degree and order 50); radius = areoid + height

order: HRSC stereo, median of registered strips
MOLA where it has laser shots in the bin
composite.registration: one height offset per strip: the median of MOLA minus HRSC over the bins with shots inside it
composite.rejection: fit RMS more than 3.0 x the median over all strips (owner, 2026-10-02)

provenance.channels: red = HRSC, green = MOLA measured, blue = MOLA interpolated; each the share of the pixel, 0-255
